title: Ankhorage Local Infrastructure
summary: Provides a safe local-host compute adapter that reports the current Node host without mutating its lifecycle.
purpose: Expose the current machine through the provider-neutral compute boundary for local development and deterministic host inspection.
responsibilities: Inspect the current Node host through the compute adapter boundary.
Return provider-neutral compute observations for the local machine.
Allow an injected probe for deterministic tests or another trusted host environment.
boundaries: Does not provision, suspend, resume, or delete the user's machine.
Does not define provider-neutral infrastructure contracts.
Does not manage containers, clusters, or remote cloud resources.
audience: Infrastructure hosts selecting the current machine as a compute target.
Tests and tools that need deterministic local-host compute observations.
useCases: Inspect the current host through the common compute adapter.
Inject a deterministic host probe for tests.
Compose local compute evidence without granting lifecycle mutation.

architecture.role: A non-destructive compute adapter for the current host.
invariants: The default adapter never performs lifecycle mutations on the user's machine.
Host inspection is replaceable through an explicit probe boundary.
Results use the provider-neutral compute contract.

security: The default adapter performs observation only and does not mutate host lifecycle.
limitations: Provision, suspend, resume, and delete operations are intentionally unsupported.
